faq.title: FAQ
faq.description: Practical notes on live direction, continuity, first frames, and access.

items.question: What is H3 Max Director?
items.answer: H3 Max Director creates a continuous realtime video stream that responds to live prompts while preserving characters, settings, and story continuity.

items.question: How is Director different from a clip generator?
items.answer: Director keeps one stream running so each new prompt can build on what already happened instead of producing an isolated clip.

items.question: What creative controls does H3 Max Director offer?
items.answer: The setup provides an opening prompt, an optional first frame, 480p or 768p resolution, and 16:9, 9:16, or 1:1 aspect ratios before moving into live direction.

items.question: Can I start from an image?
items.answer: Yes. A first frame can establish the initial character, setting, composition, and style for the continuous session.

items.question: How do credits work?
items.answer: Your current credit balance is checked before the Director workspace opens. If the balance is empty, the app sends you to pricing.

items.question: Who is H3 Max Director for?
items.answer: Creators, studios, storytellers, and teams that want to guide interactive comedy, drama, games, broadcasts, animation, or ambient worlds in realtime.
